grounding.states: the rate depends on whether the mortgage is insured, conventional or uninsured, and on the lender
grounding.from: The question doesn't say whether the mortgage is insured (under 20% down), insurable, or uninsured. It also doesn't say whether it is a new purchase or a renewal, or which lender.

value.answer: Quick check as of today: the lowest 5-year fixed I can find is about 4.34% for an insured mortgage, and around 4.44% for a conventional one. Big banks are higher, roughly 5.1 to 5.2%, and rates have been creeping up this month. Which one you get depends on your down payment and lender, so if you tell me whether you're under 20% down and whether it's a new purchase or a renewal, I can narrow it down.
